result.topic_en: Draft of the Dirichlet-principle argument: a lower bound for the integral contribution near the boundary in terms of $(\gamma_1-\gamma_2)^2 K\,ds / [\log(1-Kp_1)-\log(1-Kp_2)]$, showing that L becomes arbitrarily large for certain discontinuities. A counterexample with the growth $(\log 1/\delta)^\alpha$, $\alpha<1/2$, shows that the minimum need not be attained by continuous functions, motivating an addition to the preceding theorem.
